name: Thinking Machines Lab

source.quote: The deal, which includes participation from Nvidia, Accel, ServiceNow, CISCO, AMD, and Jane Street, values the startup at $12 billion, the spokesperson said.

description: AI lab founded in 2025 by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati; releases the Inkling open-weight models.
explain: Thinking Machines raised a record $2 billion seed round from investors including Nvidia, AMD and Cisco, money that mostly goes to renting AI chips.
